text: RUSI credits massed fire from two Ukrainian artillery brigades, more than ATGMs, with stopping the Russian thrust on Kyiv.
Delta began as an Aerorozvidka project.
In early March 2022 the Russian 90th Guards Tank Division pushed down from southern Chernihiv Oblast and took Bohdanivka, Zalissia and Velyka Dymerka.
On the evening of 9 March 2022 a column of the 6th Tank Regiment of the 90th Guards Tank Division drove south-west down the M01 highway into Skybyn.
Before the Brovary ambush the 72nd Mechanised Brigade had prepared ambushes and pre-planned artillery and mortar targets along the M01 highway.
The 72nd Mechanised Brigade's 1st and 3rd Mechanised Battalions, the 3rd under Maj. Roman Darmohrai, were at the Brovary ambush alongside Azov and Territorial Defence units.
At the Brovary ambush the Ukrainian ambushers fired anti-tank missiles at the lead vehicle and the trail vehicle of the Russian column.
After the anti-tank missile hits, artillery fell on the Russian vehicles bunched on the M01, where they had left the open fields for a stretch of highway lined with houses.
A Ukrainian drone filmed the Brovary ambush.
The Ukrainian drone clip of the Brovary ambush shows many armoured vehicles driving away apparently unharmed while others burn, and a TOS-1 moving among the exploding tanks.
The voice-over on the Brovary drone clip is a Russian officer's report: "Lots of losses. They waited for us. The Head of the convoy got into the ambush. Regiment commander killed in action."
